title: On Collaborating with the school on the survey
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：collaborate　|　正文 357 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 collaborate 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1960 the director ① collaborated with the school on the survey in the rain, and every actor in the theatre said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the director ② collaborates with the school on the survey without complaint without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ collaborate with the school on the survey at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ collaborated with the school on the survey before — a line in the poster for August 1954 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Collaborating with the school on the survey in the rain, the director said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the script at the far stage, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ collaborate on a small book of maps without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Collaborate on a small book of maps at once and never mention it again.

By 1967 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the poster, and a new actor from the next theatre ⑧ collaborates on a small book of maps in the rain every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stage, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ collaborated with the school on the survey again when nobody else would.

⑩ To collaborate with the school on the survey, my mother said in 1972, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the theatre remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the theatre forgets, somebody collaborates with the school on the survey without complaint again and somebody must collaborate with the school on the survey in the rain all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 合作（一般过去式 collaborated with the school on the survey：1960 年导演头一回这样做，淋着雨）
B. v. 合作（一般现在 collaborates with the school on the survey：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 合作（不定式 to collaborate with the school on the survey：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 合作（过去完成时 had collaborated with the school on the survey：1954 年八月的戏报上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 合作（动名词 collaborating with the school on the survey 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 合著（collaborate on a small book of maps：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去合著合写一本薄薄的地图书）
G. v. 合著（collaborate on a small book of maps：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 合作（后段两处：新来的演员照例 collaborates on a small book of maps，而母亲又一次 collaborated with the school on the survey）

answers.why: collaborate 意为“合作”，1960 年导演淋着雨合作与学堂合做那次调查，那是戏院里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 collaborated。
collaborate 意为“合作”，自那以后导演毫无怨言地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 collaborates。
collaborate 意为“合作”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯合作与学堂合做那次调查”，此处为不定式 to collaborate with the school on the survey。
collaborate 意为“合作”，戏报里 八月 那行字说明早在 1967 年之前就有人合作过，故用过去完成时 had collaborated。
collaborate 意为“合作”，导演说“合作与学堂合做那次调查这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 collaborating with the school on the survey 作主语。
collaborate 意为“合著”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去合著合写一本薄薄的地图书”，should ever 之后用原形 collaborate on a small book of maps。
collaborate 意为“合著”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻合著合写一本薄薄的地图书（collaborate on a small book of maps at once），以后再也不要提起。
collaborate 意为“合作”，新来的演员每个夜晚都照例合著合写一本薄薄的地图书，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 collaborates。
collaborate 意为“合作”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次淋着雨合作与学堂合做那次调查，用一般过去式 collaborated 叙述。
collaborate 意为“合作”，结尾那句是母亲 1972 年的话：要合作与学堂合做那次调查，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和戏院记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 collaborate 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1960 the director collaborated with the school on the survey in the rain, and nobody in the theatre forgot it.
Even now the director collaborates with the school on the survey without complaint whenever the theatre asks.
Collaborating with the school on the survey in the rain, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever collaborate on a small book of maps without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new actor from the next theatre collaborates on a small book of maps in the rain every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother collaborated with the school on the survey again, and the theatre remembered that half.
